findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 9 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 28 questions numbered 1-28; by section: 9.1 2, 9.2 2, 9.3 2, 9.4 2, 9.5 2, 9.7 2, 9.11 2, 9.13 2, 9.14 2, 9.15 2, 9.16 2, 9.17 2, 9.18 2, 9.21 2.

14 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering Coulomb's law, electric intensity and field lines, electric flux, Gauss's law and the charged sphere, potential and potential gradient, motion of charges and the electron volt, current and drift velocity, resistivity and its temperature dependence, electrical power, emf and internal resistance, Kirchhoff's rules, the Wheatstone bridge, the potentiometer, and thermistors/LDRs. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: force in a medium has εᵣ in the denominator; the Wheatstone balance is derived from equal potentials at B and D (not the printed Eqs. 9.48 and 9.49); Kirchhoff sign rules as corrected; potentiometer principle V ∝ l; the fire-alarm potential at B falls.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
